events.summary: The initial memory-summary size projection piped a PowerShell if/else expression directly and failed with an empty-pipe parse error before reading or changing repository state.
A scalar assignment before JSON projection recovered the bounded memory lookup without mutation.
The first activation-packet lines 101-200 display clipped part of a long flashcard line and earned zero full-window credit.
Separate 101-150 and 151-200 windows recovered the unchanged packet bytes through that interval.
The first all-window activation-packet display exceeded the global presentation budget and was incomplete.
Bounded 25-line windows completed the exact 496-line packet through EOF without mutation.
The first full current-state.json projection exceeded its output budget before EOF.
Four bounded windows completed all 1,556 lines and preserved the mutable snapshot read-only.
A broad activation-packet rg projection expanded repeated flashcard prose and exceeded its output budget.
Exact headings and bounded packet sections supplied the required route and lifecycle fields without repeating the broad projection.
A combined parallel manifest replay exceeded the model-context presentation boundary and produced no attributable complete aggregate.
Serial scalar-only Git-blob replays established all four manifest digests and the content seal without invoking the predecessor canonical.
The first PowerShell manifest wrapper was rejected by the command policy before execution.
A read-only Python Git-object projection used literal paths and emitted bounded scalar results.
The first isolated replay used a nonexistent manifests directory and raised FileNotFoundError before any Git-object comparison.
A literal rg file listing resolved the validation directory and the replay then used the exact committed filenames.
Parallel byte-and-digest replay reported inconsistent checkout-byte mismatches for CRLF YAML projections.
Serial replay distinguished raw checkout byte counts from normalized-LF Git-blob digests and established zero digest mismatches.
A broad D-drive receipt-name scan remained unbounded past ninety seconds and was cancelled with zero receipt credit.
A bounded search of the named canonical and validation receipt banks located the exact predecessor latch and receipt.
A depth-two D-drive directory projection expanded thousands of paths and exceeded its presentation budget.
The top-level receipt-bank names already exposed by the bounded prefix were used for exact bank-scoped searches only.
The first broad prior-Neris Git-tree projection crossed its command-yield boundary without returning a bounded file list.
Exact docs, scripts, and tests pathspecs recovered only the declared prior-owner templates without mutating them.

The first source-bounded semantic audit found one exact inherited title and ten additional titles at or above the preregistered 0.75 token-Jaccard quarantine ceiling, then failed closed before writing x1 documents.
The bounded collision report identified only the eleven affected proposal IDs; those titles were rewritten while every noncolliding proposal and the immutable source remained unchanged.
The first x1 test invocation ran before staged-manifest assembly: nine tests passed and the manifest-coverage test failed because the four owner code paths were not yet recorded.

The exact declared x1 set was staged, the manifest assembler captured the four code paths, and only the failed manifest-coverage test was selected for dependency recovery; the nine prior passes were not replayed.
The first mechanical x2 remaster retained the predecessor x1 hash in the x2 manifest and test fixtures and retained one stale Eiren source-owner exception label in the x1 builder.
A bounded owner-code scan identified the three exact stale fields; they were corrected to the immutable Neris x1 hash and Elaren v677-v2 source label before any x2 evidence builder or test executed.
The first read-only importlib inspection omitted the owner scripts directory from sys.path and stopped with ModuleNotFoundError before executing the x2 builder.
A bounded inspection inserted only the literal owner scripts directory, then established the exact source, x1, baseline, section, and runner constants without writing evidence.

The first x2 builder invocation reached owner-skill customization before the official skill-creator initializer had supplied agents/openai.yaml and failed closed after executing one zero-credit partial set of sixty positive controls and 240 rejecting mutations.

The official initializer created exactly the twenty declared owner-local skill skeletons; the failed builder was then retried from the same immutable x1, with the first sixty positives and 240 rejections retained as zero-credit replay witnesses and only the complete retry counted in the bounded ledger.
